d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

d: The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, managing, and executing retail store fit-out projects, ensuring that all projects are delivered according to the brand's design standards, technical specifications, quality requirements, approved budgets, and agreed timelines.

The role requires a qualified Engineer with strong technical knowledge, hands-on retail experience, and the ability to manage contractors and oversee all stages of store development and fit-out execution.
q: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related Engineering discipline.
Previous experience in Project Management within the retail industry is essential for minimum 5 years.
Experience in luxury fashion retail store fit-outs is highly preferred.
Ability to prepare 3D renderings and technical project visualizations.
Strong technical knowledge of construction materials, finishes, and fit-out specifications.
Proven experience in Fit-Out Quality Control (QC).
Strong experience in contractor management and site supervision.
Excellent project planning, scheduling, and timeline management skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to conduct regular site visits and monitor on-site execution.
r: Plan, coordinate, and oversee retail store fit-out projects from the initial planning stage through to final handover.
Develop project schedules, timelines, and execution plans.
Monitor project progress and ensure all milestones are achieved within the agreed deadlines.
Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
Identify potential project delays and implement corrective actions.
Prepare and review technical drawings using AutoCAD.
Develop 3D renderings and project visualizations to support store design and execution.
Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to ensure technical accuracy and coordination.
Ensure all drawings and specifications comply with the brand's design requirements.
Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of construction and fit-out materials.
Evaluate and recommend suitable materials, finishes, and specifications for luxury retail environments.
Ensure materials meet the required quality, durability, and aesthetic standards of the brand.
Coordinate material approvals and technical submissions.
Manage and follow up with contractors, suppliers, and subcontractors throughout the project lifecycle.
Conduct regular site visits and monitor contractor performance.
Ensure contractors adhere to approved project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Follow up on work progress and resolve technical or execution-related issues.
Coordinate with contractors to ensure timely completion of all project activities.
Conduct regular site inspections to monitor fit-out quality and workmanship.
Ensure all construction and installation works meet the brand's luxury standards and approved specifications.
Identify defects, deviations, and quality issues and ensure timely rectification.
Conduct final inspections and ensure projects are completed to the required standards before handover.
Monitor project schedules and ensure timely completion of all assigned projects.
Track project costs and coordinate to ensure execution remains within approved budgets.
Prepare regular progress reports highlighting project status, timelines, challenges, and pending actions.
Escalate any delays, technical concerns, or budget-related issues when necessary.
